items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: Lee Peyton, yeah. He played the chord in.

ctx.x: For a while, when he was a kid. And Buck started out with him. Up near, uh, near Amelia in the Chappapulis. I think they had a barber shop. Uh, do you remember the Peyton band? Peyton. I forget his first name. I think he was an accordion player.

Oh, yeah, Peyton. He had a, flute in, a chord in. He used to play, uh, well he didn't have no band. He just had, he used to use that flute, that chord in and the guitar, you know, complimenting. Not a big band, huh? No, he didn't have no big band. Just, just them two pieces. Never used no drum or nothing. Just that chord. Yeah. Lee Peyton. Lee Peyton. Lee Peyton, yeah. He played the chord in. Flutina called it a great, you know, one of those big chordings, you know. Oh, yeah. And he used to play up here, when…
Yeah. That was the big name for it? Bucket of Blood.
